name: What factors drive the overall cost of a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What factors drive the overall cost of a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost is largely driven by custom tile selections, fixture plumbing relocations, and structural repairs. Moving a toilet or shower drain requires subfloor access and mechanical trade work, which increases labor costs compared to keeping fixtures in place. Premium materials like natural marble, frameless glass doors, and freestanding soaking tubs also raise material expenses. Additionally, opening up walls in older bathrooms often reveals hidden leaks, dry rot, or outdated electrical runs that must be brought up to modern standards before finish work can proceed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Primary cost drivers include relocating plumbing drains, selecting custom tile or marble, replacing damaged subflooring, and adding custom carpentry or frameless glass.
